entry.title: awkward
entry.content:
humanity is cursed with the affliction, that any valuable experience in life must pass through the trial that stands the test of time, an awkward situation

i am very awkward adverse. how does one break free.

what are the fundamental components that constitute an awkward situation? i think, simply put, it just comes down to uncertainty. the uncertainty of going down a path of treachery. what if i go down a path of conversation that leads to a rut or deadend, or the path leads into a cave with treacherous cave trolls, in the form of conflict (coming off as offensive)

entry.title: conflict
entry.content:
conflict is healthy

we live in a conflict adverse reality. paradoxically, treating conflict as a problem and wanting to get rid of it has the cascade effect of creating conflict. paradoxically, the more we treat conflict as an issue, the more it becomes one. it becomes the evil that we imagined it to be.

entry.title: media refactorization
entry.content:
creating new forms of consumption out of the same creative throughpout such as turning a youtube video into a bunch of shorts, perhaps writing a blog out of the script, and chopping it up into various other forms across different platforms. or turning a stream into a video and a bunch of shorts

does refactoring content breathe new life into the things we create in a productive/positive way? does it change the nature of the original creation. does the way its spliced and put together transform something?

perhaps the answer is yes. when we take ingredients, and shuffle them and form them into something, the form of it makes it so the ingredients become greater than a sum of its parts. perhaps this is not the best analogy though since the act of cooking is creation itself. its a far more transformative act than simply chopping a video up. maybe a better analogy is taking a cucumber and turning it into slices. the utility of it changes completely. you can put it on your face now. eat it slice by slice. consumed in a way that’s easier to process.

without a doubt its beneficial for any content creator to boost their traction by spreading content as far and wide as possible monetarily its a no brainer. great benefit (more traction, more views, more money) for realtively little effort

but i mean as a whole for humanity. is it healthy for people to be able to digest information so readily in any form they choose? is there such thing as information in an unhealthy form?
entry.summary: creating new forms of consumption out of the same creative throughpout such as turning a youtube video into a bunch of shorts, perhaps writing a blog out of the script, and chopping it up into various other forms across different platforms. or turning a stream into a video and a bunch of shorts

entry.title: small
entry.content:
small things inspire me.

in the same school of thought as the lowercase aesthetic, i believe downsizing and compact form factors to be the most creatively inspiring setting.

when things are small yet performing maximally beyond what is expected from its given size, it brings me great pleasure. tickles my brain in the right way.

thats why my pc is sfx sized. i want the most compact midi controller. the smallest travel guitar

portability is a big thing for me perhaps too. the fantasy that i am able to carry entire worlds of knowledge creative potential, on my back or in my hand.

I personally believe that a laptop in an iPad form factor would transform the personal computing space profoundly. Apply are just p[]ssy ass b[]tches Or maybe i’m just selfish and would like to own a product like that myself. it would be so sick.

perhaps the change wouldn’t be that dramatic, as tablet laptops do exist. but the elegance of removing the bulky hinge piece and simplifying to this single tablet would be chef’s kiss. to me it would be revolutionary. With the modern chip architecture, this should be feasible soon. the compute in a ipad should be susbtantive, enough to be a laptop. maybe thermals are the biggest engineering problem with this kind of tech idk
